identityScope: Four existing catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Eufy product and comparison pages. X10 Pro Omni, Omni S1 Pro, L60 and Robot Lawn Mower E15 are four separate models with their own pages. No new model was created and no Eufy company focus review exists. The X10 Pro Omni page marks the product as no longer available, publishes 899.99 USD, 8,000 Pa, dual rotating mop pads, 173 minutes of vacuum run time and 136 minutes of vacuum-and-mop run time, but publishes no robot mass or battery capacity, and its comparison table disagrees with the FAQ on robot dimensions. The Omni S1 Pro page lists the model as discontinued and publishes 1,499.99 USD, 8,000 Pa, HydroJet self-cleaning and ozone disinfection, but no dimensions, mass, battery or run time. The L60 page lists the series as discontinued and publishes 5,000 Pa, iPath navigation, a 3.9 in body, 120 minutes of run time and a 3 L dust bag, but no price, dimensions, mass or battery. The E15 page publishes 1,799.99 USD, 0.2 acres, an 8 in cutting width, 1 to 3 in cutting height, 18-degree slopes, 12.5 kg, 60.3 x 39.4 x 31.8 cm, IPX6, a 93.24 Wh battery and 90 to 110 minutes of mowing and charging. No reviewed page publishes payload, travel speed, hourly area rate or water tank capacity; the catalog values for those fields remain unrecorded.

fields.description: The Eufy X10 Pro Omni is a robot vacuum and mop with 8,000 Pa suction, dual rotating mop pads at 1 kg pressure and 180 RPM, a Pro-Detangle Comb and RGB camera plus LED obstacle avoidance. It measures 13.90 x 12.87 x 4.47 in, clears obstacles up to 0.83 in and needs 5.12 in height and 13.78 in width around furniture. The all-in-one station measures 14.41 x 18.11 x 18.90 in, washes and dries the mops, refills the robot and empties the dust. Run time is 173 minutes in vacuum mode and 136 minutes in vacuum-and-mop mode in Standard mode, and the robot carries an 80 mL water tank with app, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi control. The page marks the product as no longer available. The page publishes no robot mass, battery capacity, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or minimum aisle width; the catalog mass and run time values are cleared or replaced.

fields.description: The Eufy Robot Lawn Mower E15 is a wire-free robotic mower for lawns up to 0.2 acres (8,700 sq ft) with an 8 in (203 mm) cutting width and a 1 to 3 in (25 to 75 mm) cutting height. It handles slopes up to 18 degrees and cuts grass under 3.5 in with a height difference under 1.2 in, and it is not recommended for St. Augustine or dense Zoysia grass. It measures 60.3 x 39.4 x 31.8 cm and weighs 12.5 kg, with a 93.24 Wh battery, 90 to 110 minutes of mowing per charge and 90 to 110 minutes of charging time. The robot is rated IPX6, emits under 56 dB, connects over Wi-Fi with app and OTA updates, and includes GPS, 4G and an anti-theft system plus automatic rain and low-light recall. The base station measures 72.7 x 48 x 45.2 cm, weighs 6.5 kg and is also rated IPX6. The page publishes no payload, travel speed, hourly area rate or water tank capacity.
